title: Milo requirements.json
description: The requirements a Milo project traces with @req / @derived. `milo trace` and the checker validate against these rules (src/requirements.ts loadRequirements) and reject any other field.

parent.description: The requirement this one refines. Must exist; no cycles.

derived.description: Comes from a design choice, not from a parent. Traced with @derived(ID), never @req(ID) on code; may not have a parent.

env.description: static, unit, integration, sil, hil, target, or any other lowercase token (a named rig).

verification.description: Under --strict, analysis (any env) needs a PROVEN formalizing clause and test with env absent or unit a passing @req test; every other method/env pair needs evidence, which is a gap until evidence records exist. Absent: the profile's depth rules.
